name: MevBot private tx
fix_description: In pancakeCall (0x84800812), add msg.sender validation to ensure the caller is a legitimate PancakeSwap pair. Currently any address can call this callback and trigger the bot to execute arbitrary swaps, draining its funds.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is not deeply complex, but it is a multi-step drain involving an Aave flash loan, several crafted low-level calls into a router using a hidden function selector, and Curve pool swaps to convert extracted assets. An auditor would need to understand the router’s protocol-specific token handling and why arbitrary calls can pull the router’s balances, which is more involved than a trivial access control bug but still far from a highly intricate cross-protocol exploit.
